description: A DASHA SYSTEM. Vimshottari (5 levels at asOfIso), Yogini, Ashtottari, Kalachakra, Narayana or Chara, with the period running at asOfIso and a timeline focused around it (detail: full returns every level).

asOfIso.description: ISO date-time whose running period is reported

detail.description: focused (default) keeps sub-periods only around asOfIso

place.description: Catalogue query or display label when explicit coordinates are supplied

time.description: Local birth time HH:MM (24-hour); 6:30 PM is also accepted

timezone.description: Required IANA timezone when explicit coordinates are supplied, for example Asia/Kolkata

timezoneOffset.description: Optional fallback offset; derived from timezone and the requested local date when omitted

name: calculate_dasha_system
title: Calculate a declared Dasha system
